<issue>
Dylan lexer not highlighting keywords and builtins correctly

#### Description

The Dylan lexer is no longer properly highlighting keywords, builtins, functions, and operators. All identifiers are being treated as plain `Name` tokens instead of their appropriate token types like `Keyword`, `Name.Builtin`, or `Operator`.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pygments import highlight
from pygments.lexers import DylanLexer
from pygments.formatters import TerminalFormatter

code = """
define method hello-world()
  format-out("Hello, world!\\n");
end method;

define class <person> (<object>)
  slot name :: <string>, required-init-keyword: name:;
  slot age :: <integer>, init-value: 0;
end class;
"""

lexer = DylanLexer()
formatter = TerminalFormatter()
result = highlight(code, lexer, formatter)
print(result)
```

Expected: Keywords like `define`, `method`, `class`, `end` should be highlighted as keywords, and builtins like `format-out`, `<string>`, `<integer>`, `<object>` should be highlighted as builtins.

Actual: All identifiers appear as plain names without any special highlighting.

The issue affects syntax highlighting in editors and documentation tools that rely on Pygments for Dylan code highlighting.
</issue>
